lines.zh: 我拖着长喙，在干草上爬。
lines.en: I crawl over dry grass, dragging my long snout.
Six short legs, one step at a time.
My shell clicks against the stalks.

lines.zh: 草原的太阳太毒，我往草下钻。
lines.en: The savanna sun is fierce; I duck under the grass.
I go slowly; my shell is heavy.
I go around a clump of dry brush.

lines.zh: 我的喙往前探，探路用的。
lines.en: My snout reaches forward to feel the way.

lines.zh: 踩在沙上，留下细细的足印。
lines.en: On sand I leave thin little tracks.
When the wind blows, I tuck my legs and play dead.

lines.zh: 我沿着草根走，那里阴凉。
lines.en: I follow the grass roots where it's cool.

lines.zh: 我爬过一块小石头，费了些劲。
lines.en: I climb a pebble and it takes effort.

lines.zh: 金黄的草太亮了，我贴着走。
lines.en: The golden grass is too bright; I keep low.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，找能啃的嫩芽。
lines.en: Step by step, I look for shoots to nibble.

lines.zh: 走过的地方，草叶都歪了。
lines.en: Where I pass, the blades bend aside.

lines.zh: 我的壳纹跟枯叶一个颜色。
lines.en: My shell pattern matches dead leaves.

lines.zh: 走累了，我就停在草茎上。
lines.en: When tired, I stop on a stalk.
I fold my snout to my chest and hold still.

lines.zh: 硬壳一合，我就像颗种子。
lines.en: Shell shut, I look like a seed.
I'm waiting for the sun to weaken.
An ant crosses my back.
I slowly turn my antennae to test the air.
The body under my shell is soft.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，跟石子一样。
lines.en: I stay still as a pebble.

lines.zh: 草原的声音很多，我听不清。
lines.en: The savanna is full of sound; I can't sort it.
I lift a leg, then set it down.
I rub my snout on the ground.
Too hot; I try to spend nothing.

lines.zh: 我这根长喙，专钻种子里。
lines.en: This long snout is made for burrowing into seeds.
You're so tall I can't lift my head enough.
I'm right at the edge of your shadow.
One step from you and I'm finished.
Hold still; let me work out what you are.
My eyes sit on either side of my snout.
The grass is too tall; I climb onto your shoe.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬前腿，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I raise a foreleg. Consider it a greeting.

lines.zh: 你的鞋，比我一整只还大。
lines.en: Your boot is bigger than all of me.
I won't run. I can't outrun you.

lines.zh: 我只是只虫子，你没必要动手。
lines.en: I'm just a beetle. No need for violence.
My shell's chipped. That hurts.
I curl up and don't move.
All six legs are trembling from the pain.
I'm flipped and struggling to right myself.
The fluid I'm leaking is yellow.

lines.zh: 这一下，我壳上多了道印。
lines.en: Now there's a mark on my shell.
I creep away, not daring to hurry.
I'm not dead. Don't finish it.
It hurts, but my shell held.

lines.zh: 我贴在地上，让你找不到。
lines.en: I press to the ground so you lose me.
I see that tender leaf.

lines.zh: 甜味从你指缝里漏出来。
lines.en: Something sweet leaks between your fingers.

lines.zh: 长鼻子一探，草叶就少了。
lines.en: One probe of my snout, and grass is gone.
The smell of plants — my favorite.
I extend my snout and test the distance.
Lower it a little; I can't reach.

lines.zh: 这味道让我腿都动快了。
lines.en: That smell speeds my legs up.
I'm not greedy. A small bite is enough.
I stop before it and sniff first.
All right. I'm coming over.
Don't step! The shell will crack!
One touch and I'm on my back.
On my back, I'm in trouble.
My shell is hard, but it isn't iron.

lines.zh: 我腿一蹬，好不容易翻回来。
lines.en: I kick and barely right myself.
Step back; my shell is still dusty.
That knocked me half an inch askew.
Your foot is far too close.

lines.zh: 象鼻虫的硬壳，缩成个球。
lines.en: The weevil's hard shell balls up tight.
It's fine. I'm still whole.

lines.zh: 草原上找个同伴，不容易。
lines.en: Finding a companion on the savanna isn't easy.

lines.zh: 我们慢慢靠近，先碰碰触角。
lines.en: We close in slowly, antennae first.

lines.zh: 两只虫子贴着走，就这样。
lines.en: Two beetles walking close — that's how it is.
Our antennae touch, and we understand.

lines.zh: 这地方太干，但也没别的。
lines.en: It's dry here, but there's nowhere else.
Under the grass roots, no one can see.

lines.zh: 我不急，我们有的是时间。
lines.en: No hurry. We have all the time there is.
Six short legs; wait up for me.
Let's look for shoots together.
Closer. The wind is too loud.
A grass seed fell; I pick it up.
My snout pinches it nicely.

lines.zh: 这块昆虫肉，是别的虫的。
lines.en: This insect meat belonged to another bug.
The seed is heavy; I drag it along.

lines.zh: 壳底下一放，谁也看不见。
lines.en: Tucked under my shell, no one sees it.

lines.zh: 太小了，掉了两次才拿稳。
lines.en: So small I drop it twice before it holds.
I roll it back slowly.

lines.zh: 食物得藏好，草原上谁都饿。
lines.en: Food must be hidden; everyone's hungry here.
This will last me several days.
I've picked it up. I'm not giving it back.
The grass over there is moving.
I lift my snout to judge the direction.

lines.zh: 影子盖过来，我缩了一下。
lines.en: A shadow falls; I flinch.

lines.zh: 你的脚步震得沙子在跳。
lines.en: Your steps make the sand jump.

lines.zh: 我盯着你落脚的每一下。
lines.en: I watch every place your foot lands.

lines.zh: 这不是我能对付的东西。
lines.en: This isn't something I can handle.
I retreat behind a stalk.

lines.zh: 你看见我了，那就没办法了。
lines.en: So you've seen me. Nothing for it.
I draw my legs under my shell.

lines.zh: 好啦，我盯上你了，虽然打不过。
lines.en: Fine, I've got eyes on you. Not that I can win.
There are shoots I've hidden around here.
Step aside a bit and I'll go through.
I edge into the grass step by step.
Shell against the ground, I keep from glinting.
I count the prints you leave.

lines.zh: 你在找我，我就在草根下。
lines.en: You're searching; I'm under the roots.

lines.zh: 风帮我，把你气味吹过来。
lines.en: The wind helps, bringing your scent.

lines.zh: 你抬脚那一下，我往前一点。
lines.en: When you lift a foot, I advance a little.

lines.zh: 我装成一颗石子，不动了。
lines.en: I pose as a pebble and go still.
Don't step this way.
I hide in the dry grass pile.
When the sun shifts, I'll move.
If I don't move, you can't see me.
At this distance you're one step away.
I butt your boot tip with my snout.
That probably isn't even a tickle.

lines.zh: 我爬到你鞋上，咬住鞋带。
lines.en: I climb your boot and bite the lace.
My shell knocks your finger.

lines.zh: 长鼻子一顶，只求你让路。
lines.en: A nudge of my long snout, just to pass.
I pinch, very lightly.
Don't squeeze me; I'll pinch back.

lines.zh: 这点力气，用完了我就跑不动。
lines.en: That's all my strength; after it I can't run.

lines.zh: 我蹬了你一下，翻了个身。
lines.en: I kick you and flip myself over.
Enough. Don't come back.
I crawl out of a heap of grass seed.
The savanna soil is dry. Perfect.
I land on a patch of dead grass.
Dust settles on the patterns of my shell.
I pull my snout out of the soil.

lines.zh: 这里金黄金黄的，太显眼。
lines.en: All this gold makes me conspicuous.

lines.zh: 我找了一株灌木做掩护。
lines.en: I find a shrub for cover.
Just emerged, my legs are still soft.
In the sun my shell gets hot.
The savanna is big enough to crawl at leisure.

lines.zh: 草原的火一过，壳就焦了。
lines.en: One grass fire, and my shell chars.

lines.zh: 我从草茎上掉下来，翻了两圈。
lines.en: I fall off a stalk and roll twice.

lines.zh: 水一进来，我六条腿乱蹬。
lines.en: Water gets in and all six legs kick wildly.
The blast throws me into the air.
An arrow pins me beside a grass stalk.
Magic makes my shell burn hot.
No shoots to nibble; I can only wait.

lines.zh: 雷打在旁边，我壳都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits nearby and my shell goes numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里我连翻身的可能都没有。
lines.en: In the void I can't even flip over.
